slides.say: Given: two x minus one, in absolute value, is equal to seven. Which of the following gives all the possible values of x?
So this time there's a number in front of x. And they ask for all the values, so we'll need both cases. [short pause] Two ways, two cases first, and then plugging in the answers.
at: a number in front of x

slides.say: [short pause] Our first method, two cases. Which numbers have an absolute value of seven? Seven and negative seven. So the inside is seven, or the inside is negative seven.
First case. Two x minus one is seven. To get x alone, add one, and two x is eight. Divide by two, and x is four.
at: Two x minus one is seven

slides.say: x is four, so I can already cross out number four. It doesn't have a four in it.
Now careful. A lot of students just flip the sign here and say negative four. But there's a minus one inside the bars, so let's really solve the second case.
Two x minus one is negative seven. Add one, and two x is negative six. Divide by two, and x is negative three.
at: Two x minus one is negative seven

slides.say: So four or negative three, number three is our answer. Number one forgets the second case, and number two is the flipped sign.

[pause] Our second method, plugging in the answers. Three of the choices have four in them, so let's test four first. Two times four is eight, minus one, seven. Its absolute value is seven, so four works.
And what does that tell us? Number four is three or negative four, so it leaves out four, a value that works. Number four is out.
Now the other numbers. Negative four. Two times negative four is negative eight, minus one, negative nine. Its absolute value is nine, not seven. So number two is out.

Negative three. Two times negative three is negative six, minus one, negative seven. Its absolute value is seven, so it works too. So number one, four only, misses negative three. It's four or negative three, number three.

So two cases, two answers, and don't assume they're opposites. When there's a number in front of x, or a number added inside, solve the second case all the way. [pause] Okay. I'll see you in the next question.
